[Medikabazaar](https://www.medikabazaar.com/3p?srsltid=AfmBOoqUCUzBUOFP4JfbA9M1hNpdV1LLCsqbsoIvAt2sG2Zu-TAkCne4) is an online business-to-business (B2B) health-tech marketplace that connects hospitals, clinics, and medical practitioners directly with manufacturers and suppliers of medical equipment, devices, consumables, and pharmaceuticals. It acts as a one-stop digital procurement platform to streamline supply chains and lower purchasing costs. [](https://in.linkedin.com/company/medikabazaar)

- **Digital Marketplace:** Provides a centralized e-commerce platform where healthcare providers can search, compare prices, and buy thousands of medical products ranging from basic daily consumables to advanced diagnostic machinery. [](https://in.linkedin.com/company/medikabazaar)

- **Supply Chain & Logistics:** Operates a tech-enabled warehousing and fulfillment network to deliver medical supplies directly to healthcare facilities, even in remote or tier-2 and tier-3 cities

[](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/medikabazaar_medikabazaar-makeinindia-oempartnerships-activity-7417184576634245120-fzbg)

- **Vendor & OEM Partnerships:** Collaborates with original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and verified suppliers to ensure product authenticity, competitive pricing, and wider market reach for local and international brands. [](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/medikabazaar_medikabazaar-makeinindia-oempartnerships-activity-7417184576634245120-fzbg)

- **Inventory & Procurement Tools:** Offers digital inventory management and tech solutions to help medical institutions optimize reordering and reduce asset downtime. [](https://www.facebook.com/Medikabazaar/videos/medikabazaar-the-global-medical-supplies-platform-our-mission-is-to-revolutioniz/1182232339133182/)
